description: Canonical data dictionary for Ask Your Books. Single source of truth for the LLM schema-context prompt and the data-model docs. SQLite dialect; see infrastructure/postgres/schema.sql for the Postgres port.
domain_rules: Indian financial year: 1 April - 31 March. Q1=Apr-Jun, Q2=Jul-Sep, Q3=Oct-Dec, Q4=Jan-Mar.
TODAY (config/env, default 2026-10-01) is the reference for 'current' and for ageing.
Cancelled vouchers (is_cancelled=1) are excluded from every figure.
Double entry: voucher_lines of one voucher sum to 0. Debit > 0, credit < 0.
Sign convention: expenses & receivables are debit balances (positive); income & payables are credit balances (negative). Answers always show positive human-readable INR.
Amounts are stored as integer paise (amount_paise). 1 INR = 100 paise.

org_id.description: Tenant id (ORG1..ORG3). Every row of every business table carries org_id; the guard injects org_id=session-org into every generated query.
FK organizations. Resolved server-side from the authenticated user, never from the LLM.

name.description: Ledger name. Party names appear here in Sundry Debtors / Sundry Creditors groups.

grp.description: Ledger group — the main slicing dimension for expense/income/receivable/payable questions.

vdate.description: Transaction date; the period filter for all revenue/expense questions.

voucher_lines.label: Voucher line (double entry)

amount_paise.description: Debit positive, credit negative. Lines of one voucher sum to 0.

voucher_lines.note: No org_id column: always join through vouchers/accounts. The tenant guard therefore rewrites voucher_lines as a join against tenant-scoped vouchers+accounts.

party_account_id.description: FK accounts, grp in Sundry Debtors/Creditors

outstanding_paise.description: Current outstanding in the same sign as amount_paise
